title: Rust (programming language)
text: Rust is a multi-paradigm systems programming language focused on safety and performance. It prevents memory safety bugs at compile time through its ownership system.

title: Python (programming language)
text: Python is a high-level interpreted language known for its readability. It supports multiple programming paradigms including procedural, object-oriented, and functional.

title: SQLite
text: SQLite is a self-contained serverless SQL database engine. It is the most widely deployed database engine in the world, used in browsers, mobile apps, and embedded systems.

title: Vector database
text: A vector database stores high-dimensional embedding vectors and provides fast approximate nearest-neighbor (ANN) search. Use cases include semantic search, RAG, and recommendation systems.

title: Transformer (machine learning)
text: The Transformer architecture introduced the attention mechanism and became the foundation of modern LLMs including BERT, GPT, and LLaMA.

title: BM25
text: BM25 (Best Match 25) is a bag-of-words retrieval function used by search engines to rank documents by relevance to a query. It is the default ranking in Elasticsearch and Lucene.

title: HNSW
text: Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) is a graph-based approximate nearest-neighbor algorithm. It provides logarithmic search complexity and is used in Qdrant, Weaviate, and Synapse.

title: SimSIMD
text: SimSIMD is a library providing SIMD-accelerated similarity kernels for dot product, cosine, and Hamming distance. It uses AVX-512 on Intel and NEON on ARM.

title: RAG (retrieval-augmented generation)
text: RAG combines a retrieval system with a generative LLM. The retriever fetches relevant documents; the LLM generates answers grounded in retrieved context.

title: Pinecone
text: Pinecone is a managed cloud vector database. It provides a REST API for storing and querying embeddings. Alternatives include Qdrant, Weaviate, and Synapse (self-hosted).

title: LangChain
text: LangChain is a Python framework for building LLM-powered applications. It provides abstractions for chains, agents, memory, and vector store integrations.

title: LlamaIndex
text: LlamaIndex (formerly GPT Index) is a data framework for LLM applications. It specializes in ingesting, structuring, and querying data for LLM context.

title: Mem0
text: Mem0 is an open-source memory layer for AI assistants. It persists user preferences and conversation context across sessions using a vector store backend.

title: HippoRAG
text: HippoRAG is a retrieval framework inspired by the hippocampus memory consolidation model. Its PPR (Personalized PageRank) re-ranking improves multi-hop question answering.

title: Apache Arrow
text: Apache Arrow defines a language-independent columnar memory format for flat and hierarchical data. It enables zero-copy reads between systems like DuckDB, Polars, and Pandas.

title: DuckDB
text: DuckDB is an in-process analytical SQL database. It is optimized for OLAP queries and can query Parquet, CSV, and JSON files directly without ETL.

title: PostgreSQL
text: PostgreSQL is an advanced open-source relational database. It supports JSON, full-text search, and extensions like pgvector for vector similarity search.

title: Redis
text: Redis is an in-memory data structure store used as a cache, message broker, and streaming engine. Valkey is the community fork after the 2024 license change.

title: Tokio
text: Tokio is the leading async runtime for Rust. It provides async I/O, timers, synchronization primitives, and a multi-threaded work-stealing scheduler.

title: FAISS
text: FAISS (Facebook AI Similarity Search) is a library for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors. It supports GPU acceleration and multiple index types.

title: Sentence Transformers
text: Sentence Transformers is a Python library that provides pretrained models for computing dense vector representations of sentences, paragraphs, and images.

title: OpenAI Embeddings
text: OpenAI's text-embedding-3-small and text-embedding-3-large models produce high-quality dense vectors for semantic search and RAG applications.

title: Matryoshka Representation Learning
text: MRL trains embeddings that remain meaningful when truncated to shorter dimensions. A 1536-dim embedding can be truncated to 128 dims with minimal quality loss.

title: Cosine similarity
text: Cosine similarity measures the angle between two vectors. It equals the dot product of unit-normalized vectors and is the standard metric for dense vector search.

title: Graph neural network
text: GNNs learn representations of graph-structured data by aggregating features from neighboring nodes. Used in recommendation, drug discovery, and knowledge graphs.

title: Knowledge graph
text: A knowledge graph stores facts as (subject, predicate, object) triples. SPARQL is the standard query language; Cypher is used in Neo4j and Synapse.

title: PageRank
text: PageRank is a link analysis algorithm that assigns importance scores to nodes in a graph. Google's original search ranking was based on PageRank.

title: Bloom filter
text: A Bloom filter is a probabilistic data structure for set membership queries. It uses multiple hash functions and allows false positives but never false negatives.

title: FTS5
text: FTS5 is SQLite's full-text search extension. It provides BM25 ranking, phrase search, prefix queries, and trigram tokenization.

title: mmap
text: Memory-mapped files allow a file to be accessed as if it were in RAM. Databases like LMDB, SQLite WAL, and Synapse use mmap for zero-copy reads.

title: SIMD
text: Single Instruction, Multiple Data (SIMD) instructions operate on multiple data points simultaneously. AVX-512 processes 16 float32 values per instruction on x86.

title: Ed25519
text: Ed25519 is a public-key signature algorithm based on Curve25519. It produces 64-byte signatures and is used in SSH, TLS, and Synapse doc signing.

title: WAL (Write-Ahead Logging)
text: WAL writes changes to a log before applying them to the main database file. It allows concurrent reads during writes and enables crash recovery in SQLite and PostgreSQL.

title: CRDT
text: Conflict-free Replicated Data Types allow distributed systems to merge concurrent updates without conflicts. They are used in collaborative editors and distributed databases.

title: Raft consensus
text: Raft is a consensus algorithm for distributed systems. It elects a leader who manages log replication to followers, ensuring consistency across replicas.

title: Quantization (ML)
text: Quantization reduces model precision from float32 to int8 or binary to decrease memory and speed up inference. Synapse uses int8 quantization for its in-memory index.

title: Reranking
text: Reranking is a two-stage retrieval approach: a fast first-stage retriever (BM25 or dense) is followed by a slower but more accurate cross-encoder or LLM reranker.

title: ColBERT
text: ColBERT is a late-interaction neural retrieval model. It computes token-level embeddings and uses MaxSim scoring for high-accuracy retrieval.

title: SPLADE
text: SPLADE (Sparse Lexical and Expansion) produces sparse learned representations for retrieval. It combines the efficiency of sparse search with neural understanding.

title: Hybrid search
text: Hybrid search combines lexical (BM25) and dense (vector) retrieval results, typically via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) or linear interpolation.

title: RRF (Reciprocal Rank Fusion)
text: RRF combines rankings from multiple retrieval systems by summing reciprocal ranks. It is parameter-free and robust to score distribution differences.

title: ANN (approximate nearest neighbor)
text: ANN algorithms find vectors close to a query vector without exhaustive search. Common methods include HNSW, IVF, PQ, and LSH.

title: Product quantization
text: PQ compresses high-dimensional vectors by splitting them into sub-vectors and quantizing each independently. Used in FAISS for billion-scale search.

title: Lucene
text: Apache Lucene is a Java full-text search library. It powers Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, and Solr. BM25 is its default similarity function since version 6.

title: Elasticsearch
text: Elasticsearch is a distributed search and analytics engine built on Lucene. It supports full-text search, vector search (kNN), and aggregations.

title: Qdrant
text: Qdrant is a vector database written in Rust. It provides gRPC and HTTP APIs, supports filtering, and runs as a standalone service or cluster.

title: Weaviate
text: Weaviate is an open-source vector database with a GraphQL API. It supports multi-modal data and built-in vectorization modules.

title: Chroma
text: Chroma is an AI-native open-source embedding database. It is popular for prototyping RAG applications but lacks production-grade persistence.

title: Milvus
text: Milvus is an open-source vector database designed for billion-scale similarity search. It supports multiple index types and distributed deployment.

title: LanceDB
text: LanceDB is an open-source vector database built on the Lance columnar format. It provides zero-copy access and is designed for multimodal data.

title: Cursor (IDE)
text: Cursor is an AI-first code editor built on VS Code. It supports MCP tool servers for extending AI capabilities with custom tools.

title: Claude Code
text: Claude Code is Anthropic's terminal-based AI coding assistant. It supports MCP servers and has native file system, bash, and search tools.

title: MCP (Model Context Protocol)
text: MCP is an open protocol for connecting LLMs to external tools and data sources. It defines tool definitions, tool calls, and resource access patterns.

title: Anthropic
text: Anthropic is an AI safety company that builds the Claude family of LLMs. Claude models excel at coding, reasoning, and following complex instructions.

title: Ollama
text: Ollama is a tool for running open-weight LLMs locally on macOS, Linux, and Windows. It supports Llama, Gemma, Phi, Mistral, and other models.

title: Maturin
text: Maturin is a build tool for Rust-Python packages using PyO3 or cffi. It builds and publishes Python wheels containing Rust extensions.

title: PyO3
text: PyO3 provides Rust bindings for Python. It allows writing Python extension modules in Rust with safe, ergonomic abstractions.

title: CLIP (model)
text: CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training) by OpenAI learns joint embeddings for images and text. A text query can find semantically similar images.

title: Sentence-BERT
text: SBERT fine-tunes BERT with a siamese network objective to produce semantically meaningful sentence embeddings for semantic textual similarity.

title: all-MiniLM-L6-v2
text: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 is a compact 384-dim sentence embedding model. It is fast, runs on CPU, and is popular for local RAG applications.

title: nomic-embed-text
text: nomic-embed-text is an open-source 768-dim text embedding model with a long 8K context window, competitive with OpenAI ada-002.

title: FastEmbed
text: FastEmbed is a lightweight Python library for computing text embeddings using ONNX models. It avoids heavy PyTorch dependencies.

title: ONNX
text: ONNX (Open Neural Network Exchange) is an open format for ML models. It allows models trained in PyTorch to run efficiently on CPU via ONNX Runtime.

title: CoreML
text: CoreML is Apple's ML framework for on-device inference. It runs on Neural Engine, GPU, and CPU and supports image, text, and tabular models.

title: Metal (GPU API)
text: Metal is Apple's low-level GPU API for macOS and iOS. It provides compute shaders for ML inference and is used by MLX and CoreML.

title: MLX
text: MLX is Apple's array framework for ML on Apple Silicon. It provides NumPy-like operations that run on the Neural Engine via Metal.

title: Apple Silicon
text: Apple Silicon (M-series chips) combines CPU, GPU, and Neural Engine in a unified memory architecture. M4 Max has 128GB unified RAM.

title: Tokio (async)
text: The Tokio async runtime for Rust provides the foundation for high-performance network services, supporting millions of concurrent connections.

title: Axum
text: Axum is a web framework for Rust built on Tokio and Tower. It provides type-safe routing, extractors, and middleware.

title: Hono
text: Hono is a lightweight web framework for TypeScript/JavaScript. It runs on Bun, Deno, Cloudflare Workers, and Node.js with 200K+ req/s throughput.

title: Bun
text: Bun is a fast all-in-one JavaScript runtime and toolkit. It is 5-10× faster than npm for installs and includes a bundler, test runner, and SQLite driver.

title: Drizzle ORM
text: Drizzle is a TypeScript-first ORM with SQL-like syntax. It generates type-safe queries and runs on SQLite, PostgreSQL, and MySQL.

title: LibSQL
text: LibSQL is a fork of SQLite with replication support. It powers Turso's serverless SQLite offering and supports HTTP, WebSocket, and embedded connections.

title: TanStack
text: TanStack provides open-source tools for web apps: TanStack Query (async state), TanStack Router (type-safe routing), and TanStack Table.

title: Biome
text: Biome is a fast formatter and linter for JavaScript/TypeScript written in Rust. It replaces ESLint + Prettier with a single tool.

title: Tauri
text: Tauri is a framework for building desktop apps with web frontends. It uses OS webview instead of bundling Chromium, resulting in small binaries.

title: shadcn/ui
text: shadcn/ui is a collection of accessible React components built on Radix UI and Tailwind CSS. Components are copied into the project, not imported.

title: Tailwind CSS
text: Tailwind is a utility-first CSS framework. Tailwind v4 rewrites the engine in Rust/WASM for near-instant JIT compilation.

title: Auth.js
text: Auth.js (formerly NextAuth) is an open-source authentication library for JavaScript. v5 supports any framework and provides adapters for Drizzle, Prisma, and more.

title: BetterAuth
text: BetterAuth is a framework-agnostic TypeScript authentication library with built-in email/password, OAuth, and MFA support.

title: Stripe
text: Stripe is the leading payment processing API. It supports one-time payments, subscriptions, invoicing, and connect marketplaces.

title: Resend
text: Resend is a developer-first email API built on top of SMTP. It provides React email templates and reliable transactional delivery.

title: Railway
text: Railway is a deployment platform for full-stack apps. It provides Postgres, Redis, and custom service deployments with zero configuration.

title: Fly.io
text: Fly.io deploys Docker containers globally with low-latency routing. It supports persistent volumes, private networking, and Postgres Flex clusters.

title: Docker
text: Docker packages applications and their dependencies into containers. It enables consistent deployments across development, staging, and production.

title: cargo-nextest
text: cargo-nextest is a faster Rust test runner. It runs tests in parallel processes, provides better output formatting, and supports test partitioning.

title: Bacon
text: Bacon is a background Rust compiler watcher. It runs cargo check/clippy/test on file save and displays errors with context.

title: mold linker
text: mold is a high-performance linker for Linux. It links large Rust projects in 1-2 seconds vs ld's 30 seconds.

title: sccache
text: sccache is a compiler cache for Rust, C, and C++. It caches compilation outputs and supports cloud storage backends for CI speed-up.

title: Valkey
text: Valkey is the Linux Foundation fork of Redis after the 2024 BSL license change. It is fully compatible with the Redis protocol.

title: DragonflyDB
text: Dragonfly is a high-performance Redis-compatible in-memory store. It uses a shared-nothing architecture and is 25× more memory efficient than Redis.

title: Meilisearch
text: Meilisearch is an open-source search engine with a simple HTTP API. It provides instant search, typo tolerance, and faceting out of the box.

title: Typesense
text: Typesense is an open-source typo-tolerant search engine written in C++. It is an alternative to Algolia and Elasticsearch for self-hosted deployments.

title: Plausible Analytics
text: Plausible is a lightweight, open-source web analytics platform. It is privacy-friendly, cookie-free, and can be self-hosted on a single VPS.

title: GDPR
text: The General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is EU law on data privacy. It requires consent, data minimization, right to erasure, and breach notification.

title: Raft (distributed)
text: Raft ensures distributed log consistency via leader election and log replication. It is simpler to understand than Paxos and widely used in etcd and TiKV.

title: uv (Python)
text: uv is an extremely fast Python package manager written in Rust by Astral. It replaces pip, virtualenv, and pyenv with a single 10-100× faster tool.

title: Ruff
text: Ruff is an extremely fast Python linter and formatter written in Rust. It replaces flake8, isort, and black with one tool running in milliseconds.

title: CatBoost
text: CatBoost is a gradient boosting library from Yandex. It handles categorical features natively, trains faster on CPU, and provides SHAP explanations.

title: LightGBM
text: LightGBM is Microsoft's gradient boosting framework. It uses leaf-wise tree growth and is faster than XGBoost on large datasets.
